title: My Home and My Town
grammar_title: Grammar: there is / there are · in, on, under, next to… · a / an

sentences: There is a bank near my house.
يوجد بنك قريب من بيتي.
There are three bedrooms in my flat.
توجد ثلاث غرف نوم في شقتي.
Is there a pharmacy near here?
هل توجد صيدلية قريبة من هنا؟
The keys are on the table.
المفاتيح على الطاولة.
The supermarket is next to the mosque.
السوبرماركت بجانب المسجد.
Excuse me, where is the station?
عفوًا، أين المحطة؟
Go straight and turn left.
امشِ على طول ثم انعطف يسارًا.
It's opposite the hospital.
إنه مقابل المستشفى.
My flat is small but nice.
شقتي صغيرة لكنها جميلة.
Come in and sit down, please.
تفضّل ادخل واجلس.

grammar.intro_ar: «يوجد» = There is / There are. لا تقل It has a bank near my house — قل There is a bank near my house.
notes: a + consonant sound: a bank, a hospital · an + vowel sound (a, e, i, o, u): an apple, an office

exercises.title: Exercise 1 — Complete with is or are.
items: 1. There ___ a sofa in the living room.
2. There ___ two windows in the kitchen.
3. There ___ many shops in my street.
4. There ___ a park opposite the school.
6. ___ there any restaurants in your area?

write_speak:
Write & Speak — Describe your home in 6 sentences. Then explain the way from your home to the nearest shop.
Example: I live in a flat in Nasr City. There are two bedrooms and a big living room. There is a sofa next to the window. The kitchen is small. There is a bakery opposite my building. Go out, turn right, and the supermarket is next to the mosque.
